textbookText: Concept to know: The orbit that the Earth goes round the sun is elliptical, resulting in varying distances between the Sun and the Earth during different seasons. This variation in distance leads to a corresponding variation in gravitational force. The resistive force acting on a satellite is directly proportional to its speed. Since the speed is greater during the descent phase, a satellite with small mass tends to experience more resistance during descent, causing it to burn up during this phase rather than during ascent.

1) Find the value of g from the motion of the moon, assuming that its period of rotation round the Earth is 27 days and 8 hours and that the radius of its orbit is 60.1 times the radius of the Earth (Radius of the Earth is 6.36 × 106m).
Solution: Here, Time period, T = 27 days and 8 hours. = (27×24×60×60) s + (8× 60× 60) s = 2361600s Physics, Grade 11 | 170
